title: 24/7 ppl rock v.4
author: duck yun
desc:
Train six days across a focused, high-volume weekly split.
Build strength and muscle with full-gym barbell, machine, and bodyweight work.
Barbell rows anchor upper-body training, while squats and hinges develop the lower body.
Cycling adds an athletic conditioning element to the week.
Scale loads and variations to match your experience and finish the week stronger.
